title.narrative: Irish Aid to Sudan HF for 2025

description.narrative: In light of the serious humanitarian needs in the country, an additional voluntary flexible contribution to UNOCHA's Country Based Pooled Fund in Sudan, the Sudan Humanitarian Fund (SHFS), will support their objectives in line with the Sudan Humanitarian Needs and Response Plan (HNRP) for 2025 to provide safe, timely, principled and gender-responsive assistance to the most vulnerable groups; to improve living and protection conditions for vulnerable displaced persons, host communities and residents; and to provide safe, equitable, dignified and unhindered access to critical basic services. This will include activities to support food security & livelihoods, health, water, sanitation and hygeine, and general protection services. The HNRP will target 20.9 million people in need of assistance.
